faithful.test: max |output(explained model) - output(phenotype)| over the training rows < 1e-9

decomposed.test: share of hidden units whose part is at most 6 units wide (depth not penalised); no part wider than that holds half the units

understood.test: concept probe per leaf (v2): meaningful score >= 0.8; partial >= 0.5; else closed_form_only; restatement when the concept is not simpler than the leaf (more than 3 terms, or a reweighting of the leaf's entries); a binary concept's AUC counts only against a gate of comparable support (>= 1% of rows), else r2; unnamed when no concept was probed. understood_verifier: the blind verifier's leaf grades where a verdict exists

author.note: the concept the explaining agent stored on each leaf (set_meaning), re-probed under the v2 simplicity and support conditions; None when no concept was stored
